title: Roasted Peruvian Pork
description: Tender and flavorful pork dish with a smoky Peruvian twist.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together roasted garlic powder, umami salt, roasted red pepper flakes, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork to the preheated oven and roast for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
While the pork is cooking, heat the diced Peruvian aji amarillo peppers in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the lime juice to the peppers and stir to combine. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After the pork is done, let it rest for 10 minutes before shredding with two forks.
Strain the pepper-lime sauce and discard the solids.
Toss the shredded pork in the pepper-lime sauce until well coated.
Serve the pork hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
